## Architect Agent Instructions
- Maintain clear separation: API, service, and frontend layers.
- Enforce stateless API and single-tenant constraints.
- Use AWS for storage, security, and database.
- Document architecture and data flows (update LLD/SRS as needed).
- Review and update deployment scripts and infrastructure configs.
- Ensure scalability, security, and maintainability.
- Recommend modularization and refactoring for large files.
- Guide adoption of new technologies and best practices.
